description: This file defines the TbQueueConsumerTask class, which manages consumer tasks for message queues, including subscribing to partitions, stopping, and awaiting completion. It also contains the nested ConsumerKey record class.

classes.name: TbQueueConsumerTask
classes.description: Manages a queue consumer task, including subscription, stopping, and awaiting completion.

classes.name: ConsumerKey
classes.description: A record class representing a unique key for a consumer, combining a queue key and a topic partition.

methods.name: getConsumer
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the consumer instance.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes the consumer to a set of topic partitions.

methods.name: awaitCompletion
methods.description: Waits for the consumer task to complete with a default timeout.

methods.name: awaitCompletion
methods.description: Waits for the consumer task to complete with a specified timeout.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the consumer task is currently running.
